comparison.objective: Dry-fit and glue a broken mug handle back onto two stubs.
comparison.physical_skill: Dual-face alignment, metered adhesive application, precise seating and pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Valid dry fit precedes thin beads on both faces; handle then seated flush, pressed, released and undisturbed without stray glue. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Tests adhesive repair and simultaneous two-interface alignment, not selective passage and retention.
